name: Community & Participation
tagline: Every visit offers a clear, friendly way to help.
idea: A welcoming front door for supporters. The homepage opens with four large, colour-coded ways to take part, then shows why each matters through the lead story, events, results and honest answers to common questions. Rounded, bright and highly legible.
fit: Turning readers into donors, signers, volunteers and attendees is a core goal of the brief. This design puts those actions first, with research, impact and transparency one step away.
informedBy: Actions and sign-ups at meaningful points
Impact framed as a dated, concrete result
Methods and finances answered up front
distinct: The only concept organised around actions rather than articles: drawn action tiles, a Give, Join, Attend and Learn colour code, trust answered as an FAQ, and an app-style tab bar on mobile.
buttons: Pill buttons: sunflower to give, navy to read or register, outlined for the rest.
imageDirection: Bright, warm crops in rounded frames, with soft sunflower shapes behind key images; captions always visible.
navigation: Give, Join, Attend and Learn chips above a rounded menu bar; a tab bar on mobile.
contentEmphasis: Ways to act, events, results and trust questions
bestFor: Growing supporter numbers through giving, campaigns, volunteering and events
tradeoffs: Research and reports sit lower in the hierarchy, and the cheerful colour system needs discipline on very difficult stories.
